topic.title: Formatted Name Practice
topic.description: Takes a first and last name and returns them formatted in title case. A gentle introduction to defining and calling functions with return values.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Defining a function with parameters, using str.title() for formatting, and returning a value.
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding the difference between printing inside a function and returning a value.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add optional middle name parameter and handle empty string input.

files.description: Formatted name function — version 2 with variation.
